forecast.action_conditioning: independent of chosen move; assumes current interaction=True can open adjacent door; all returned actions interact
forecast.coordinates: relative to episode origin, from cumulative observed displacement
forecast.hidden_state: source mass for each visible anonymous occupied cell; heuristic unseen enemy background; no persistent enemy identities or hidden occupancy trajectories
forecast.target: at least one enemy at a grid coordinate after one enemy tick

interventions.frozen: freeze expected counts and their decay at initial zero counts, hence uniform attempted law
interventions.no_planning: continue prediction learning but use uniform-law occupancy forecasts in the identical planner; not prediction-free planning
interventions.predictive: learned attempted law used for occupancy forecasts/planning

limitations: Only this exact source is approved for risk reconstruction; reassess selected source after search.
Counts decay can change law without new informative observations; distinguish updates from parameter change.
Anonymous overlapping enemies and unseen terrain are approximated.
No prediction-use intervention removes all prediction: it replaces adaptive law with uniform-law prediction.

planner.continuation: Two-tick unconditional occupancy plus first-tick occupancy for entry, combined as independent hazards; not conditioned on survival and not a calibrated total collision probability. Static path potential is a heuristic.
planner.immediate: In predictive mode risk is the same horizon1 dictionary exported before environment transition. Uniform-law intervention recomputes this dictionary with law=1/9. Current visible occupied destinations excluded.
planner.memory: Target hysteresis and visit counts remain; fixed-law paired actions should be identical despite predictive learning.

predictive_adaptation: Anonymous feasible assignment marginalization yields expected attempted-direction counts, with .965 decay and count cap45, plus one pseudocount per direction. Parameter drift includes forgetting when enemies are not observed; updates counter measures informative sources.
state_separation: Map, observation-based localization, last-seen steps, visits, observed occupancy and previous-frame buffer always update. These do not use expected counts. Counts update exclusively in _learn, suppressed by learn=False.
status: early interface smoke, not selected-program evidence
